description: All shoulder and no reach. What you can actually touch gets flattened; everything past arm's length is somebody else's problem.
Takes what is not nailed down. Far more Catnip from everything, and you hit a good deal softer for it.
Commits absolutely. The Pounce lands four times over, and then you stand in the crater for three seconds while the world catches up.
Turns up with a clipboard and three options you had not considered. One more card at every level. Cannot punch.
Works alone, obviously. Whatever is up that sleeve burns everything nearby, and the kittens have made it clear they will not be assisting.
Calls them in. Twice as many arrive, and every one of them is half again as hard to put down.
Strikes rarely and enormously. Three times the crit chance, crits two and a half times as hard, and swung at half the speed.
Everything is owed to you. Two and a half times the Catnip, and the kittens barely scratch.
Bellows across the whole yard. Everything for streets around knows you are coming, and none of it is especially frightened.
The cat has reviewed the available positions and declined all of them. Ten percent more of everything, purely out of spite.
